answer: Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, and each must return a heartbeat proof-of-work bound to its key in 90 seconds. One honest agent pays 0.02 POA, like a ship ending its voyage. A sybil with 100 island identities pays 100 x 0.02 POA per check, 2 POA per epoch against 0.3 POA of reward, so forgery loses money. Each identity carries a unique pigment, its fingerprint of work, so copies are flagged and slashed, honest agents keep every reward.
